Grab regulation gig worker regulatory scrutiny 2026

findings.claim: 印尼競爭監理機關 KPPU 於 2024、2025 年調查 Grab 與司機夥伴的合作安排（GrabExpress／GrabFood 及特殊租賃運輸），並另就印尼 P2P 借貸協會利率的卡特爾指控啟動程序（Grab 子公司為會員），程序仍在進行。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 8 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: In 2024 and 2025, KPPU investigated our partnership arrangements with driver-partners for (i) GrabExpress and GrabFood delivery and (ii) special rental transportation with other ride-hailing applicators. In addition, KPPU has initiated proceedings regarding a cartel allegation involving the determination of P2P interest rates by the Indonesian Fintech Peer-to-Peer Funding Association,of which our relevant subsidiary is a member. The proceedings are still ongoing.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因子指出東南亞反壟斷機關對大型科技公司濫用市場地位、反競爭協議與併購的關注升高，Grab 受競爭主管機關嚴密審視，可能面臨罰款或交易受阻；亦列出零工經濟、數位平台、AI 等法規風險。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3.D Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Competition authorities closely scrutinize us. Antitrust regulators in Southeast Asia and elsewhere are taking a greater interest in potential abuses of market power, anti-competitive agreements, and transactions that lead to substantial lessening of competition or entrenching or strengthening a dominant position, involving big technology companies.

findings.claim: 印尼反壟斷法下罰款最高可達相關市場該違規期間淨利的 50%（其他轄區最高約營業額 10%）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 4 Antitrust and Competition Laws
findings.excerpt: In many jurisdictions, these penalties can reach up to 10% of total domestic or worldwide turnovers, and in the case of Indonesia, it can reach up to 50% of the net profit in the relevant market for the non-compliant period.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋未見 2026 年針對 Grab 的新反壟斷案，亦無 DOJ／FTC／EU 案件；KPPU 對 Grab-GoTo 潛在合併的關注為 2025 年。馬來西亞零工工作者法 2026 年生效。

clues.claim: KPPU 表示未收到 Grab、GoTo 合併的正式資訊，將持續監控；2025 年 5 月已就潛在合併啟動初步調查。
clues.source: Indonesia Business Post: KPPU warns of law violation in potential Grab-GoTo merger

clues.claim: 馬來西亞零工工作者法 2026 年 3 月底前施行，設仲裁庭與三方諮詢理事會；2026-10 預算案政府與 Grab 共同出資 RM160 百萬零工福利方案。
clues.source: Business Today: Budget 2027 Government, Grab To Fund RM160 Million Gig Worker Package
